context.retroactive_note: Implementations already committed to main. This step produces retroactive design artefacts documenting the interface decisions made during those commits.

task.description: WF-03 Step 2 (retroactive design) for ISS-0816/ISS-0821/ISS-0822. Document the CursorPage<T> wire shape decision (has_more removal, count optional), the test fixture integrity principle, and the /admin/modules route removal decision.

ISS-0816_ISS-0821: AC1: The four fixtures no longer fabricate has_more; each mock matches a response shape some real route actually emits
AC2: Tests still meaningfully cover pagination via next_cursor
AC3: A mechanism makes this class harder to reintroduce: fixtures checked against real response shape
AC4: Lands with or after ISS-0816's type fix
ISS-0822: AC1: Either Letflow.Routers.ProcessModules is implemented and mounted so /admin/modules works, OR the SPA route/page are removed or explicitly gated behind unavailable-feature state
AC2: The decision is recorded against S5's scope
AC3: If surface is kept, every modules.ts call is audited against real mounted route table
AC4: No other SPA route is left pointing at a router from router.ex deferred table

cursor_page_shape.decision: CursorPage<T> is {items, next_cursor, count?} — count is optional because Pagination.page_response/2 routes emit it but hand-built routes (definitions/search, dlq, promotions) do not. has_more is not a field; the backend never emits it.

has_more_removal.decision: has_more removed from CursorPage<T>. audit.ts and promotions.ts were client-deriving Boolean(response.next_cursor) solely to satisfy the required field — a derivation that added no information and masked the wrong type.

fixture_integrity.decision: All four fixture sites updated to emit only keys a real route actually emits. cursor-page-wire-shape.test.ts (TC-ISS0821-03) uses Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call to assert has_more is absent as an own property — catches has_more: false as well as has_more: true.
fixture_integrity.prevention_mechanism: Compile-time: structural typing causes tsc to reject re-introduction of has_more: boolean as a required field. Runtime: TC-ISS0821-03 catches it post-compile.

modules_route_removal.decision: SPA route /admin/modules removed outright (not gated). Letflow.Routers.ProcessModules is deferred to S5. Frontend stubs (api/modules.ts, hooks/useModules.ts) retained as S5 stubs with no live callers.
modules_route_removal.s6_cleanup: Dlq, Services, PlatformMigrations, Webhooks removed from router.ex deferred table — all four are now mounted in api_pipeline.ex (S6 complete).
